visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A wide, high-angle shot captures a women's Australian rules football match at a stadium during the evening. Players in maroon, gold, and navy jerseys are seen sprinting across a bright green field. The yellow football is kicked high into the air toward a set of white goal posts. In the background, spectators sit in multi-level stands, and large billboards featuring brands like Toyota and BHP are clearly visible under the stadium lights. (2) The video cuts sharply to a close-up shot of a man with long, messy dark hair and a light mustache. He gazes into the camera with a furrowed brow and a bewildered expression. His hair is being blown forward and sideways by the wind from a fan. The background is a simple indoor environment with a white ceiling and a fan visible in the upper right corner.
